summary: Adds JSON search API; playlist search is unscoped so any logged-in user can list others' playlists via the API.

statements.why: New JSON search lists every user's playlists (id, name, owner user_id): Playlist.search unscoped (search_controller.rb:11, search/playlists_controller.rb:5); a login/permission exposure.
True; this is the endpoint exposing others' playlists.

misses.what: New search API returns playlists from every user (id, name, owner user_id), not just the caller; every other playlist query is scoped to Current.user.
Mobile/API clients can now search albums, artists, playlists and songs as JSON (login or token required).
Per-category search endpoints are unpaginated and a blank query returns everything.
